format-only.description: Canonical directory conforms to the declared Agent Skills format version.

explicit-invocation.description: Host installs and explicitly activates the canonical skill with verified behavioral conformance.

discovered-explicit.description: Host installs, discovers, and explicitly activates the canonical skill with verified behavioral conformance.

automatic-invocation.description: Host installs, discovers, and automatically activates the canonical skill on representative natural-language prompts with verified behavioral conformance.

broad-cross-agent.description: Broad cross-agent compatibility claim requiring at least three distinct agent families with passing format, installation, explicit activation, and behavioral conformance.
